_comment: Budget for `npm run test:perf`. `gates` fails the build; `reference` is printed for a human and does not. The gated metric is a count (`jsdomFileCount`), so it is machine-independent: it caps the subset of files that each pay ~106ms of jsdom construction (ADR: isolated/node 40ms vs isolated/jsdom 147ms per file, environment 81% of the jsdom figure). `fileCount` was demoted from `gates` to `reference` on 2026-10-18: a total prices every file the same and ratcheted continuously (930 -> 1060 -> 1062 -> 1093), so only the fixed-cost driver gates now; the total is still printed as an advisory. See dev-docs/ADR/2026-09-26-test-suite-execution-time-contract.md (R4 and the 2026-10-18 entry). The JSON reporter cannot measure fixed cost — both time columns cover the test phase only — so wall is the sole figure that includes it and wall is machine- and worker-count-dependent (76.9s at 6 workers, 184s at 3, 303s at 2 on one 8-core box). Raising a gate requires an ADR note recording the trajectory and the cause, because a bare raise only resets the clock. jsdomFileCount trajectory (PBI 2026-10-19-08 measured it from git history): 360 at introduction (c2e28943, exactly the count then) -> 359 when src/__tests__/manifest.test.ts dropped its jsdom docblock (004b05c7; it now verifies wxt.config.ts, so it needs no DOM) -> 362 after three jsdom suites were added (opfsWorker-loadShedRetry 7a3a39e0, pausePanel b9f9df3c, maintenanceBatchHandler-purge-plan ce410903) -> raised to 362 on 2026-10-18 (65057bf0, CI measured 362/360) -> raised to 374 on 2026-10-25 (CI measured 374/362 on PR #198 and main; +14 jsdom suites added, -2 removed with dead code: see ADR 2026-10-25 entry for per-file attribution) -> raised to 398 on 2026-11-02 (CI measured 398/374 on this branch; +21 jsdom conversions on main since 426d0ca8 plus 3 new DOM-wiring suites on this branch: collectionClauseEditorView, historyToCollectionHandoff, sessionToCollectionHandoff: see ADR 2026-11-02 entry for per-area attribution). The ADR entry lists the per-file attribution and the raise procedure. -> raised to 403 on 2026-11-07 (CI measured 403/398 on main; +4 migration-path suites in cff908df and +1 saved-collections first-run suite in ff9ccdf6, all 2026-11-06: see ADR 2026-11-07 entry for per-file attribution).
